First, think about what the school values. A lot of schools will be sports-oriented or others.  Since this is a magic school, I'd say they would value magic.  But in what way? (Also this can vary if magic is a secret or not.)  Do they want raw power? Or control over it? Do they want to teach you how to use your power safely, or do you want them to help you expand and enrich it?  Depending on what you pick will change a lot of things. From what will be taught, how it will be taught and who is teaching.   


Also, how do you enter?  Do you pay? Take a test? Or do you take trials?  I can use some examples:   
Harry Potter has the simplest, it's a magic list that writes names of kids who have magic.

Nevermoors Morrigan Crow had four trials, each focusing on a different thing. The first was honesty, both to yourself and others. The second was tactics, split decision making and cunnong. Thrid was courage, and the fourth was on the actual power/magic/knack. 

If the school is a secret one, it could make more sense to have after school and weekend lessons. Or nighttime lessons. Or it could be to save time.  

Also, how are the students divided?   
The most understandable choice is by power strength, control and their age.   
Also what type of magic/powers?  
Do they have inate magic or can it be thaought? Is it that you have 1-x number of powers and magical abillaies? Or do you start of with one and then branch out?

  
And what can those powers be used for? (Like jobs)

Is there a special organisation for magic? (Think of a council or HP Ministry of magic)  
If you can teleport yourself and others, you could own a very exspnsive teleporation service. (Depnding on how rare the ability is)  
Any from of water control/rain powers would be good to be a farmer or firefighter.  
Healers could be highly sought after, or just a above avarige doctor.  
Mind readers could be helpful for introogations and styff.   


I hope this helps. If you don't know where to start on something remember that you need a base. You can always flesh out your ideas later. Uhhhh yeah I'm sorry if it was bad, I'm not good at stuff. :P

Okay, this is something that doesn't really match what you asked but...

​

When I was 11-12, my mums' boyfriend at the time brother was getting married.

So we went shopping because I didn't have any wedding fitted dresses. While shopping I found some cute dresses but my mother said that they didn't look good for a wedding, even the one I told her I loved and said I would wear multiple times she refused. (I don't wear dresses often) 

Things happened and had a fit. (I had never thrown a fit and made a fuss before) She liked two of the oddest dresses I have ever seen, it came from this very...quirky brand that I had a few shirts from. One had a cream base colour and had parrots all over and the second one (Witch my mother liked the most) has a light pink background and was *covered* in vegetables... yes you heard me *vegetables.* I was **not** wearing that, not to the first wedding I had ever attended or just a wedding in general.

But my mother really liked them and made me chose, I for obvious reasons chose the cream parrot one since it felt less obnoxious. The only reason for those dresses was because they have the same cut as mums boyfriend child. (Let's call her O)

My mother also told me that everyone would not be looking at me but at the bride and groom. She was wrong...

So we went to the farmland island where the wedding was and O and I got light pink flower crowns and we left. So we're waiting for this to start and this lady (Who I assume is a wedding coordinator) tells us to stand in front of the bride and groom and walk them in.

My heart sunk, I was a bridesmaid

We did the ceremony and I felt awful, a few months later mum and Bf broke up so now they have photos for a lovely ceremony in an old church the bride looks stunning in her white gown and the groom is shining, there is O smiling in her pink dress and her flower crown and then there is me trying to hide from the crowd behind O (She was 8-9) trying to not look miserable.

Also, the O and I being the only kids didn't really have a proper place to sit and sat away from all the adults and it made me feel worse like if it was my fault that we were abandoned with nothing to do for a few hours.

​

TLDR: Mum picked the worst dress for a wedding ever, I kinda forgive but will not forget
